name: Hand Of God
overview: The 'Hand of God' in Scripture symbolizes God's powerful and righteous intervention on behalf of His people. The right hand is frequently associated with strength, victory, and divine support, as seen in Exodus 15:6 where God's right hand defeats the enemy, and Isaiah 41:10 where God promises to uphold His people with the right hand of His righteousness. The imagery of God's hand extends to His creative power, highlighting His handiwork in the heavens (Psalms 19:1), while the right hand also signifies a place of honor and authority, as in Psalms 110:1 where the Lord is seated at God's right hand until His enemies are subdued. The mention of the left hand, though less emphasized, complements the understanding of God's comprehensive power and presence.
